summary: Phase 6 (Equip System + UI Password Reset) end-to-end validation completed. Backend pytest 117/117 PASS. All Phase 6 backend smoke-test curls behave per spec (equip/unequip route shape, password-reset request always 200, confirm rejects bad token 400 and weak password 400). All Phase 6 frontend flows render and behave per spec with correct data-testids: Login forgot link, /password-reset/request, /password-reset/confirm (weak-pw + bad-token errors visible both as inline error and sonner toast), /adventurers (adv-power-* + equip-link-*), /adventurers/:id/equipment (3 slot sections, lock banner correctly absent for available adventurer, base/equipment/total power columns 31/+0/31 for freshly recruited), /inventory (empty-state). Gameplay regression constants verified: goblin-warrens base_duration_seconds=60, required_team_size=3, recommended_power=45; recruitment cost_gold=20.
critical_code_review_comments: Adventurers page emits two equip-link elements per row (desktop + mobile). The desktop one uses data-testid=equip-link-<id> and the mobile uses data-testid=equip-link-mobile-<id>. Naming is fine, just worth noting for future test selectors so .first()/exact matchers don't surprise testers.

Phase 6 password-reset/confirm correctly returns HTTP 400 with the exact spec'd message for weak passwords; the dungeons endpoint uses the field name base_duration_seconds (not duration_seconds as the review request hinted). Constants match: 60s / team 3 / power 45. No action needed; clarifying for next agent's grep.
